Settings

Make LinkLens work and look the way you like. Every change is saved automatically.

Copying

How text is copied from a page.

Default copy formatUsed by element, card and section copies. Markdown keeps links as [text](url).
Default extraction behaviourWhat clicking a card or section does.
Heading style (plain text)Plain keeps headings as simple lines; Markdown adds # prefixes.
Include buttons & CTAsAdd button text such as “[Read more]” to card and section copies.

Interface

What you see on the page while a tool is active.

Floating toolbarShow the action toolbar next to the highlighted element.
Element type labelsDisplay H2 HEADING, PARAGRAPH, CARD … on highlights.
Link previewShow a small live preview of where a hovered link goes. Loads the page after a short pause; sites that forbid embedding show a hint.
Preview sites that block embeddingMany sites (statista.com, GitHub, Google…) refuse to be shown in a preview frame. Turn this on to preview them anyway: LinkLens then relaxes frame-blocking headers only for the preview frame it creates, never for the pages you browse. Chrome will ask for access to all sites when you enable it; turn it off to give it back.
Toast notificationsConfirm each successful copy on the page.
Highlight colourOutline colour used on pages. “Theme” follows the theme you picked.

History & privacy

Your copies stay on this computer.

Keep copy historyStores your last 25 copies locally in this browser. Never transmitted.
Clear history—

Keyboard shortcuts

Quick ways to start and use the tools.

Open a tool

    While a tool is on

      Alt+E, Alt+S, Alt+Shift+S and Alt+C work from anywhere. Once any tool is on, every tool above is one key away (press it again to turn the tool off). To start any tool from anywhere, give it a key at chrome://extensions/shortcuts: Chrome only lets an extension suggest four by itself.

      Appearance

      Pick a theme. It recolours this page, the popup and every tool on the page instantly.

      Reset

      Go back to the defaults.

      Reset all settingsRestore the defaults, including the theme. Copy history is kept.
